entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Scaffold-DbContext flag to force update (without deleting other entities) #37796
  • Update json schema for property name changes in complex property during migration #37792

Closed

  • Some NTS Geometry objects endup as invalid Geographies in Sql Server #37416
  • RevEng: Decimal column with same precision and scale as the default produce warnings at runtime #12241
    11.0.0
  • DbContext scaffold missing IndexerProperty for M2M relation after upgrading from EF Core 6 to EF Core 8 #35524
    11.0.0
  • Impossible to add a migration with efcore 10 when targeting net48 #37745
  • Still no way to configure mappings of complex property when registering as convention? #37721
  • EF Core incorrectly tracks computed property as modified with wrong original value when using navigation-based property #37455
  • How to set comment with `ComplexProperty`. #37587
  • When a transaction is rolled back, the ChangeTracker does not accurately reflect the state of the entities it is tracking #37408
  • Can't change state of entity with complex collection #37724
    10.0.5
  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools missing target framework #37515
    10.0.5
  • Cannot override named query filters set via convention #37708
    10.0.5
  • Deleting an item from a ComplexCollection, that contains an array results in Error #37585
    10.0.5
  • ApplyMigration: The model for context 'xxxxx' has pending changes #36309
  • An error was generated for warning 'Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Migrations.PendingModelChangesWarning' #37517

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37793
  • Fix ExecuteUpdate over scalar projections #37791
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37790
  • Fix RowVersion concurrency issue when replacing entities with TPH inheritance and owned types #37788
  • Fix in-memory corruption of nested owned entities after SaveChanges when navigation is replaced #37787
  • Fix HasDiscriminator with default name "Discriminator" failing for non-string types #37785
  • Fix complex property JSON column not marked nullable in TPH hierarchy #37781
  • [release/8.0] Update SDK to 8.0.124 #37780
  • [release/9.0] Update SDK to 9.0.114 #37779

Merged

  • RevEng: Always scaffold HasPrecision for decimal columns in SQL Server #37730
    community-contribution
  • Emit all properties on the join type, even when there's no extra configuration #37783
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37789
  • [release/10.0] Fix projection of entities with complex collections through subqueries #37747
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.5
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37782
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37760

Updated

  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix owned entities with default values not saved in TPH with shared columns #37751
  • Use port 8800 for Cosmos emulator on Helix #37110
